report_review.required_scope: Selected GT-conditioned extreme-window box-response diagnostic; neither detection gain nor rejection of trained dynamic selection.

pilot_static_checks.MIL: softplus(-amax(box logits)); base object/frame average within each window then four-window average. No box-filled pixel target.
pilot_static_checks.negative_masks: Only crop core [9,119) supervised. Every valid annotation bbox including other sizes/classes, ignored/crowd boxes, is excluded with 2px margin; positives require complete bbox in core.
pilot_static_checks.extra_targets: Same absolute anchor frame, same crop, all strict non-overlapping <=16px valid boxes; pair window indices 2*pi/2*pi+1 and slots anchor-start.
pilot_static_checks.random_pair_control: Separate RNG, permutation uses all 2N terms once, rejects same-original-object pairs, N<2 disabled for all strategies.
pilot_static_checks.BN: All parameters including affine require grad; model.train then every BN.eval; running means/vars/counters checked exactly after every optimizer step.
pilot_static_checks.shared_budget: One hashed plan, strict official checkpoint load and fresh Adam. Invocation-level matching of LR/checkpoint/script hashes across strategies still needs run records.
